newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Shinsegae Merchant sets rights offer.
newsitem.headline: Shinsegae Merchant sets rights offer.

text.p: South Korea's Shinsegae Merchant Bank said on Wednesday it would offer a 39-for-100 rights issue in January to raise operating funds.
The issue will increase the bank's paid-in capital to 30.45 billion won from 20.45 billion.

A bank statement said the bank plans to issue two million common shares, of which 20 percent would be offered to its employees. The rest will be allocated to shareholders registered as of December 18.
The issue price will be set at a 25 percent discount to the base price, which will be decided later, the statement said.
Subscription is scheduled for January 15 and 16, with payment due by January 29.
In late afternoon trading on Wednesday, Shinsegae shares were down 300 won to 9,300 won.
